def _convert_tools_to_openai_format(tools: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
    """Convert flat tool format to OpenAI function format.
    Handles: {"type":"function","name":"Foo","parameters":{...}}
    And:    {"type":"function","function":{"name":"Foo","parameters":{...}}}"""

        else:

    return converted
